name: Roast Pepper-Pork Patties with Carrot, Cucumber, Almond & Dill Salad

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Divide between two medium bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (12 oz) jar roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Add pork, bread crumbs, egg, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with the peppers. Use your hands to combine the pork mixture. Using a ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground pork
1 egg
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the second bowl with the peppers.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Add carrots, almonds, and vinaigrette to the bowl, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (10 oz) bag shredded carrots
⅛ cup almonds, sliced
2 tbsp French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide patties and salad between plates. Enjoy!
